newsitem.title: CANADA: ARC Intl says gets US$12 mln in funding.
newsitem.headline: ARC Intl says gets US$12 mln in funding.

text.p: ARC International Corp said on Thursday it is expanding its ARC Sports Ltd unit into the United States and has secured US$12 million in financing to develop U.S. sites for hockey and figure skating facilities.

The funding was secured from New York-based fund adviser Brown Simpson LLC through Cowen and Co. ARC said ARC Sports will announce its initial U.S. site in the first half of 1997. The site should be operational by the Fall of 1997.
Under terms of the financing agreement, ARC may issue up to US$12 million of convertible debentures in five tranches. It has completed the first US$2.5 million tranche, due 2000.

The debentures are convertible into ARC International common shares at a discount to the prevailing price at the time of conversion. The conversion price adjust upwards if the price of ARC's common stock hits certain levels.
ARC said it retains the right to repurchase the debentures at any time at a predetermined formula that is based on the market price of ARC's common shares at the time of purchase.
The remaining US$9.5 million of debentures can be issued in four tranches.
ARC said the convertible will accrue interest at four percent, payable in cash or stock at the time of conversion.
In connection with the deal, ARC has issued to the investor a warrant to buy 489,000 shares of its common stock at US$5.83, a 55 percent premium above ARC's January 8 closing price.
